notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Replication Technique
description:
Cast Replication Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Replication Technique, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
